people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
translations.bsb: You will show faithfulness to Jacob and loving devotion to Abraham, as You swore to our fathers from the days of old.
translations.kjv: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
translations.asv: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the lovingkindness to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
